description: A shell script utility ('clawlog') designed to access and filter VibeTunnel logs on macOS, providing options for viewing, filtering, searching, exporting, and real-time streaming of logs related to the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays an error message and instructions when sudo permissions are insufficient for log access.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command options for the clawlog script.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and displays recent unique log categories within the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user input to safely embed in macOS log predicates.
